artist.name: Josh Wink
artist.profile:
After forming [l=Ovum Recordings] as an independent label in October 1994 with former
      partner [a=King Britt], Josh recorded the cult classic "Liquid Summer." 
      
      He went on to release singles for a wide variety of revered European labels ranging from
      Belgium's [l=R & S Records] to England's [l=XL Recordings]. In 1995, Wink became one of
      the first DJ-producers to translate his hard work into mainstream success when he unleashed a
      string of classics including "Don't Laugh," "I'm Ready," and "Higher State of Consciousness,"
      that topped charts worldwide. More recently he has had massive club hits such as "How's Your
      Evening So Far," and "Superfreak," but he has also gained a lot of attention through his
      remixes for [a=FC Kahuna], [a=Paul Oakenfold], [a=Ladytron], [a=Clint Mansell], [a=Sting] and
      [a=Depeche Mode], among others.
